data.location: 1855 Deerfield Rd. Suite F, Highland Park, IL 60035

Hawaiian Bros Island Grill will open at 250 Highway 53 in Calhoun, according to Tomorrow's News Today Atlanta. Franchise group MRCO is behind the location.

Hair Cuttery will open in Wendell Commons, a retail hub under development, on May 1, 2027. The salon is part of the company's plan to open more than 20 salons across the Raleigh and Charlotte markets by 2028.

data.status: aiming to welcome its first students later this winter
data.short_description: Franchisees Augustine and Evgeniya Smith have signed the lease for a Fred Astaire Dance Studios location. They are working with a construction team to set a build-out schedule. The exact opening date is tentative.
PNC Bank appears to be heading to 2161 Roswell Road in East Cobb, according to Tomorrow's News Today Atlanta. The site was formerly an Arby's. When it will open is unclear.

A tropical swamp-themed bar and restaurant is coming to the Johnston Street strip in Lafayette. It will offer cold drinks, hot food and live music. It takes over the former Legend's Bar & Grill space, and crews have already redone the exterior with a green facade and tiki touches.

Planning documents show EōS Fitness plans a Johns Creek gym in a space formerly home to Kroger. It offers strength equipment, free weights, group classes and coaching. More gyms are planned in Dunwoody, Alpharetta and Austell.

Monica and Luther Maday, a Cherokee County couple, are opening a franchise of this salon for men in Woodstock. It will offer haircuts, shaves, beard work, manicures, pedicures and VIP memberships, with five stylists at full capacity. The franchise already has locations in Suwanee and Gainesville.

This maker of hypoallergenic bath, beauty and fragrance products is opening its first standalone storefront in Oakdale. It was founded in 2014 by Lori Butler and has so far sold through booths inside other stores. The shop will carry home fragrance, bath and body items, men's products and gift baskets.

data.short_description: A plan review filing with the Orange County Health Care Agency suggests Alfred Coffee may open in Newport Beach. The filing is still pending, and no opening date has been confirmed. Alfred is based in Los Angeles and has locations across LA and in Austin.

data.location: 2455 Research Forest Dr, The Woodlands, TX 77381
data.short_description: A TDLR permit shows Artisan & Vine is expected to open in the Research Forest Lakeside shopping center. The business combines a specialty grocery store, café, bakery, wine shop and coffee shop. It grew out of Tres Market, which was founded in 1996.

data.status: "preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar location"
data.short_description: By the Sea Coffee, a mobile espresso cart business based in Manchester-by-the-Sea, is opening its first café inside the Cape Ann YMCA. Founder Emily Bayog hopes to open in January 2027. The café will serve espresso drinks, matcha, smoothies, toasts and grab-and-go food.

data.store_name: Clawtel Foods Boil House and Market
data.short_description: A TABC permit shows this seafood boil restaurant and market is expected to open in Royal Oaks Plaza in West Houston. Co-owner Dustin Clawson confirmed the opening. It grew out of Clawtel Ranch Foods, a Gulf Coast seafood and specialty foods brand.

data.location: 2727 E Oakland Park Blvd, Suite 100, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306
data.status: "preparing to open for the first time"
data.short_description: A Florida DBPR permit shows this new sandwich shop is expected to open in the Coral Ridge Country Club Estates neighborhood. Owner Gary Triangle confirmed the opening and is hiring staff. No other details have been shared.

Masala Art, an Indian restaurant based in Needham, is opening a second location in the former Clay Oven space in Lexington. Owners Vinod and Shikha Kapoor announced the expansion on social media. The menu puts a modern spin on traditional Indian and Indian-Chinese dishes.

data.status: "final day at the current location will be December 31, 2026"
data.short_description: This Indian-inspired halal smash burger restaurant is leaving its spot upstairs at the Monarch Tavern after nearly two years. It will keep regular hours there until December 31.
Bindi's Burgers is moving to a larger space in Toronto that has not been announced yet. The bigger space will let it expand its menu.

IronOak Social is a social club with four TrackMan golf simulator bays, a restaurant and a bar. Its website lists January 2027 as the expected opening, though a later date is possible. Owner David Braswell is offering founding memberships.

data.location: 2510 West Coast Highway, Newport Beach, CA 92663
data.short_description: Uchi, a Japanese-inspired restaurant founded by Chef Tyson Cole, is opening in Newport Beach. The menu features sushi, sashimi, seasonal dishes and omakase. Its website lists dinner hours and says it accepts reservations.

data.location: 550 McCaslin Blvd, Unit B (Relish Food Hall), Louisville, CO 80027
data.short_description: GetRight's, a family-owned artisan bakery, is opening its second location at Relish Food Hall. No opening date has been announced. Until then, the team plans weekend pop-ups at the site.

Brelundi, a Sicilian restaurant group, is planning a casual restaurant in an under-construction mixed-use development on the Concord River. Founder Michael Colomba confirmed the plans. Other planned tenants include Two Putt and a brewery.

Ggiata, a sandwich shop based in Los Angeles, is expected to take over the former Baycrest Bottle Shop space in Costa Mesa. It serves an East Coast-style Italian deli menu known for chicken cutlet sandwiches. This would be its first Orange County location.

data.location: 1060 Hero Way, Building 3, Suite 330, Leander, TX 78641
data.short_description: Wonder, a food hall that sells dishes from multiple restaurant brands through one platform, is opening near H-E-B Plus in Leander. It will have dine-in, pickup and delivery. The brands for this location have not been announced.

data.status: "getting ready to open"; "working on the buildout"
data.short_description: Ripple Coffee, a neighborhood coffeehouse, will take over the former Parlor Doughnuts space. It is a program of the nonprofit Rylie's ARK and has filed for a retail food license and signed a lease. No opening date has been announced.

data.short_description: Maison Park, an omakase restaurant from Chef Antonio Park, is preparing to open at The Ritz-Carlton, Toronto. It will have an omakase bar setting. It joins the hotel's existing restaurants: EPOCH, TOCA and LANO.

data.short_description: Pure Superfood has signed a lease for a space inside Emeryville Public Market. The business currently operates a location in Santa Rosa. The opening date has not been released yet.
Ace of Wingz plans to open its seventh restaurant in a former Quiznos space in Tucson. No opening date has been announced.
The article says the Ace of Wingz shop in Tempe, which What Now Phoenix covered in June, is now open. It is one of the chain's six current restaurants.
